broker_change.scope: Host and dedicated-account runner. Does not select PSEC.
broker_change.first_resume: Host calls ResumeThread on the verified payload thread after checking exact Job membership, token handoff, namespace and job limits. With a two-place budget, the account runner occupies the other place. The host independently reads NoChildProcessCreation and AllowSecureProcessCreation on the retained payload handle before resume.
broker_change.completion: The host verifies termination and the exit code on the retained root handle. An interrupted launch before resume has no payload exit code.
broker_change.observer: Host retains the exact-member handles through the fixture's observation. An additional cleanup handle must compare equal to its observed kernel object before use.
